upload_contract.start: Upload as START frame; exact first-frame anchor.
upload_contract.key: Upload as KEY frame; peak beat reference.
upload_contract.end: Upload as END frame; final-frame target.

reject_focus: Keep monitor_required. Run prompt-against-frame QA, strict Shot024->025 and 025->026 continuity QA, and a 3-second motion probe. Reject if Byleth enters this frame, any performer crosses the ravine, the gate or two guards disappear, the path becomes straight, Lonato becomes a face-to-face target, START/KEY/END collapse into one pose, or Chinese/Mandarin voice, subtitles, UI, borders, or pasted cutouts appear.
promotion_rule: Do not promote to approved_for_video from this package alone. A human or separate reviewer must inspect the generated 3-second clip and record motion_review_passed before full-duration generation.
